figures_reviewed.label: Fig. 1
figures_reviewed.caption: Chromosomal-level assembly of complete genomes for great apes. a , b , A comparative alignment of HSA7 ( a ) and HSA16 ( b ) compared with syntenic chromosomes from chimpanzee, bonobo, gorilla, Bornean orangutan and Sumatran orangutan. Each chromosome is compared with the chromosome below in this stacked representation using the tool SVbyEye ( https://github.com/daewoooo/SVbyEye ) 116 . Regions of collinearity and synteny (positive in blue) are contrasted with inverted regions (negative in yellow) and with regions beyond the sensitivity of minimap2 (homology gaps), including centromeres, subterminal and interstitial heterochromatin or other regions of satellite expansion. A single transposition (green in  b ) relocates about 4.8 Mb of gene-rich sequence in gorilla from HSA16p13.11 to HSA16p11.2 (see Fig.  3  for more detail).
figures_reviewed.review_scope: Original publisher image opened; viewer resized some images. No final-size reproduction QA.

figures_reviewed.label: Fig. 3
figures_reviewed.caption: Inversions and evolutionary rearrangements in great apes. a , Alignment plot of gorilla chromosome 18p and HSA16p shows a 4.8 Mb inverted transposition (yellow). SDs are shown with blue rectangles.  b , Experimental validation of the gorilla chromosome 18 inverted transposition using FISH with probes pA (CH276-36H14) and pB (CH276-520C10), which overlap in human metaphase chromosomes. The transposition moves the red pB probe further away from the green pA probe in gorillas, resulting in two distinct signals. FISH on metaphase chromosomes using probe pC (RP11-481M14) confirmed the location of a new inversion to the terminal end of the short arm of PAB chromosome 2. Each FISH experiment was repeated three times, and ten metaphase spreads with the corresponding fluorochromes were captured for each experiment. Scale bar, 1 µm.  c , An evolutionary model for the generation of the inverted transposition through a series of inversions mediated by SDs.  d , Alignment plot of orangutan chromosome 2 homologues to HSA3 highlights a more complex organization than previously known by cytogenetics 117 : a new inversion of block 5A is mapping at the terminal end of the short arm of chromosome 2 in both PAB and PPY.  e , A model of serial inversions requires three inversions and one centromere repositioning event (ENC) to create PPY chromosome 2, and four inversions and one ENC for PAB. Red asterisks show the location of SDs mapping at the seven out of eight inversion breakpoints. ANC, ancestor.
figures_reviewed.review_scope: Original publisher image opened; viewer resized some images. No final-size reproduction QA.

figures_reviewed.label: Fig. 5
figures_reviewed.caption: Organization and sequence composition of the ape acrocentric chromosomes. a , Sequence identity heatmaps and satellite annotations for the NOR +  short arms of both HSA22 haplotypes across all the great apes and siamang chromosome 21 (the only NOR +  chromosome in siamang) drawn with ModDotPlot 120 . The short-arm telomere is oriented at the top of the plot, with the entirety of the short arm drawn to scale up to but not including the centromeric α-satellite. Heatmap colours indicate self-similarity in the chromosome, and large blocks indicate tandem repeat arrays (rDNA and satellites) with their corresponding annotations given in between. Human is represented by the diploid HG002 genome.  b , Estimated number of rDNA units per haplotype for each species. HSA chromosome numbers are given in the first column, with the exception of s-21 for siamang chromosome 21, which is NOR +  but has no single human homologue.  c , Sum of satellite and rDNA sequences across all short arms for which one haplotype is NOR +  in each species. ‘Unlabelled’ indicates sequences without a satellite annotation, which mostly comprise SDs. The total number of SD bases is given for comparison, with some overlap between regions annotated as SDs and satellites. Colours for sequence classes are as for  a .  d , Top tracks, chromosome 22 in the T2T-CHM13v2.0 reference genome displaying various gene-annotation metrics and the satellite annotation. Bottom tracks, for each primate haplotype, including the human HG002 genome, the chromosome that best matches each 10 kb window of T2T-CHM13 chromosome 22 is colour coded, as determined by MashMap 121 . On the right side of the centromere (towards the long arm), HSA22 is syntenic across all species; however, on the short arm, synteny rapidly degrades, with very few regions mapping uniquely to a single chromosome, a result reflective of extensive recombination on the short arms. Even the human HG002 genome does not consistently align to T2T-CHM13 chromosome 22 in the most distal (left-most) regions. acro, acrocentric; mat, maternal; pat, paternal.
figures_reviewed.review_scope: Original publisher image opened; viewer resized some images. No final-size reproduction QA.

figures_reviewed.label: Fig. 6
figures_reviewed.caption: Assembly of 237 NHP centromeres reveals variation in α-satellite HOR array size, structure and composition. a , Sequence and structure of α-satellite HOR arrays from the human (T2T-CHM13), bonobo, chimpanzee, gorilla, Bornean orangutan and Sumatran orangutan chromosome 1–5 centromeres, with the α-satellite SF indicated for each centromere. The sequence and structure of all completely assembled centromeres is shown in Supplementary Fig.  XIX.66 .  b , Variation in the length of the α-satellite HOR arrays for NHP centromeres. Bonobo centromeres have a bimodal length distribution, with 28 chromosomes showing minicentromeres (with α-satellite HOR arrays <700 kb long); two-tailed Mann–Whitney test, * P  < 0.05; NS, not significant (compared to human, * P  = 0.044,  P  = 0.103, * P  = 0.0001,  P  = 0.287 and * P  = 0.0099 for bonobo, chimpanzee, gorilla, Bornean and Sumatran orangutans, respectively).  c , Correlation between the length of the bonobo active α-satellite HOR array and the length of the CDR for the same chromosome.  d , Example showing that bonobo and chimpanzee chromosome 1 centromeres are divergent in size despite being from orthologous chromosomes.  e , Sequence identity heatmap between the chromosome 17 centromeres from bonobo and chimpanzee show a common origin of sequence as well as the birth of new α-satellite HORs in the chimpanzee lineage.  f , Sequence identity heatmap between chromosome 5 centromeres from the Bornean and Sumatran orangutans show highly similar sequence and structure, except for one pocket of α-satellite HORs that is only present in the Bornean orangutan. For  d – f , data are for haplotype 1.
figures_reviewed.review_scope: Original publisher image opened; viewer resized some images. No final-size reproduction QA.

figures_reviewed.label: Fig. 7
figures_reviewed.caption: Subterminal heterochromatin analyses. a , Overall quantification of subterminal pCht and α-satellites in the African great ape and siamang genomes for haplotypes 1 and 2. The number of regions containing the satellite is indicated below the species acronym. The pCht arrays of diploid genomes are quantified by megabases, for ones located in the p arm, the q arm and the interstitial region.  b , c , Organization of the subterminal satellite in gorillas ( b ) and the  Pan  lineages ( c ). The top shows a StainedGlass alignment plot indicating pairwise identity between 2-kb-binned sequences, followed by the higher order structure of subterminal satellite units, as well as the composition of the hyperexpanded spacer sequence and the methylation status across the 25 kb upstream or downstream areas of the spacer midpoint. The average per cent of CpG methylation is indicated as a blue line, and the band of lighter blue represents the s.d. of the methylation.  d , Size distribution of spacer sequences identified between subterminal satellite arrays.  e , Methylation profile of the subterminal spacer SD sequences compared to the interstitial orthologue copy.

plot_recipes.data_contract: PAF pairwise alignments (12 core fields, strand, sequence lengths; cg/NM tags required by selected operations) plus per-species GRanges annotations and explicit species/haplotype order.
plot_recipes.code_binding: Paper explicitly credits SVbyEye. This snapshot supplies its implementation and vignette, not the final Fig.1 driver or exact parameters.
plot_recipes.preplot: Read/filter PAF; set seqnames.order explicitly. plotAVA keeps adjacent rows only, reverses minus-strand endpoints and swaps query/target where necessary; curves are Bezier polygons computed with ggforce.
plot_recipes.palette: Published: blue direct, yellow inverted; red centromeres, pink satellites, purple subterminal heterochromatin; green highlights the transposition. Observed hue semantics, not sampled exact HEX. Package default is + forestgreen and - cornflowerblue and must be overridden.
plot_recipes.layout: Six species in shared row order; two wide chromosome panels stacked; bp converted to Mb consistently; annotations on sequence baselines, separate categorical legends at right.
migration_checks: Never relabel an alignment gap as confirmed sequence absence.
Record alignment filtering; repeated segments may have low mapq.
PAF is 0-based half-open, GRanges generally 1-based closed; make conversion explicit.
Fix order and coordinate conventions; no independent panel sorting.

plot_recipes.data_contract: Locus PAF with strand and saved genomic bounds; query and target gene/SD GRanges; block definitions. Experimental images and ancestral-event models are separate source materials.
plot_recipes.code_binding: SVbyEye API/implementation transfer; no final paper-specific assembly script verified.
plot_recipes.preplot: Subset the same biological locus in both assemblies; paf2coords handles minus-strand endpoints and a continuous scale, optionally synchronizes query x coordinates. addAnnotation distinguishes target/query/self spaces and translates query annotations.
plot_recipes.palette: Fig.3 uses pale blue background alignments, yellow inversion and colored blocks shared between alignment and model. Exact final palette/driver unavailable; source defaults are not publication values.
plot_recipes.layout: Wide alignment plus slim gene/probe tracks; FISH panel at right; transformation model below. Local plots and schematics retain their own coordinate semantics.
migration_checks: Preserve original query and target coordinates alongside plotting transforms.
Synchronizing display x coordinates does not create a genomic lift-over map.
Probe/centromere labels require actual coordinates, not arbitrary marks.
Do not turn observed alignment patterns into a proven evolutionary event sequence.

plot_recipes.published_reference: Fig.7b,c (StainedGlass, 2-kb bins); Fig.5a explicitly uses ModDotPlot, whose code was not audited here.
plot_recipes.data_contract: StainedGlass processed paired intervals: #query_name/query_start/query_end/reference_name/reference_start/reference_end/perID_by_events/strand. Genomic annotations and methylation tables are additional inputs.
plot_recipes.code_binding: Fig.7 caption explicitly names StainedGlass. Current tool pipeline/plotting code reviewed; article-specific parameter file and final composite not found.
plot_recipes.preplot: refmt sorts by matches, keeps one best hit per query/reference window pair, mirrors intervals and deduplicates. perID_by_events=100*matches/(matches+mismatches+insertion_events+deletion_events). Triangle rotates bin positions with w=first+second, z=-first+second, then builds diamond polygons.
plot_recipes.palette: Tool uses reversed Spectral. get_colors uses quantile breaks, not fixed identity percent thresholds. ONECOLORSCALE controls global vs per-sequence coloring; raw percent values must be retained and displayed accurately.
plot_recipes.layout: Triangle with identity histogram inset; repeat architecture and spacer composition below; methylation line plus SD band aligned to spacer midpoint. make_plots uses annotation_custom or cowplot for histogram only; full methylation/annotation composite is not in this script.
migration_checks: Use common fixed identity breaks when comparing loci/species; do not label quantile classes as fixed percentages.
Match histogram fill and heatmap fill to the same breaks.
The histogram display starts at the 0.1% identity quantile; disclose view truncation.
Leave unaligned cells blank instead of inserting zero identity.
Keep 2-kb binning distinct from pixel resolution.

plot_recipes.published_reference: Author repository divergence diagnostic/supplementary context; exact published panel not bound.
plot_recipes.data_contract: Author interspecies/intraspecies divergence CSVs: NAME, CHRGRP A/X/Y, BIN_SIZE, DIFF, GAP_OTHER, DIV. Preserve directed reference/other comparison; SNV and GAP rows are duplicated views of each window.
plot_recipes.preplot: Compute window missing-state fractions separately; code DIFF is mismatches/(matches+mismatches), conditional on aligned nucleotides, while GAP_OTHER is missing-other positions/all window positions. Expand each window into SNV/GAP rows; set fixed species/metric factor order.
plot_recipes.palette: Source color order A/X/Y = #673AB7/#D55E00/#0072B2; migrate as a NAMED vector rather than relying on factor order.
plot_recipes.layout: Vertical metric/species facets, overlaid A/X/Y densities; fixed bw=0.01, interspecies mean marks and autosomal within-species dashed mean. Source exports 7 x 7 inch PDF; this is not a verified final Nature page layout.
migration_checks: stage_data_part2.R contains an executable exit() before source/read processing; not a ready-to-run driver.
Source roundMe ignores its numbers argument and rounds to 4 decimals.
Terminal bins are shorter; distinguish equal-window means from base-weighted means.
Large Y peaks may reflect few windows; window counts do not equal biological n.
NA is not zero; A-vs-B and B-vs-A have different reference denominators.

plot_recipes.data_contract: Shared reference assembly and locus; genomic annotation intervals, sequence-class or mapping windows, and methylation mean/SD with the original aggregation unit. For paired loci, preserve distinct query/target coordinates.
plot_recipes.code_binding: Published layout/legend observation; article-specific track/composite code not found in the three audited snapshots. Do not present this recipe as executable reproduction.
plot_recipes.palette: Separate sequence-class colors from identity gradient and methylation blue; Fig.5d uses explicit multi-mapper/no-mapping classes. Methylation line+SD band comes from Fig.7 caption; band must not be relabeled CI.
plot_recipes.layout: Shared locus ticks and vertical alignment; categorical annotations as thin horizontal tracks; orthologue self/paired heatmaps around a common square; species/haplotype order fixed. Fig.6a shares an Mb scale across centromere small multiples, with CDR diamonds.
migration_checks: No mapping, multi-mapping and unique mapping remain separate states.
Do not independently normalize the physical width of each centromere when comparing array lengths.
CpG percentages and fractions cannot share an unlabeled scale.
Tracks require chromosome ID, orientation and coordinate-conversion records.
Printed final-size alignment and labels remain unverified until rendered.

runtime_gaps: SVbyEye is not installed here; several dependencies are absent, see source-audit.json.
No final article-specific figure driver or complete supplementary assembly verified.
No ape whole-genome alignment, FASTA or methylation analysis rerun.

learned_contract.data_contract: PAF pairwise alignments (12 core fields, strand, sequence lengths; cg/NM tags required by selected operations) plus per-species GRanges annotations and explicit species/haplotype order.
learned_contract.code_binding: Paper explicitly credits SVbyEye. This snapshot supplies its implementation and vignette, not the final Fig.1 driver or exact parameters.
learned_contract.preplot: Read/filter PAF; set seqnames.order explicitly. plotAVA keeps adjacent rows only, reverses minus-strand endpoints and swaps query/target where necessary; curves are Bezier polygons computed with ggforce.
learned_contract.palette: Published: blue direct, yellow inverted; red centromeres, pink satellites, purple subterminal heterochromatin; green highlights the transposition. Observed hue semantics, not sampled exact HEX. Package default is + forestgreen and - cornflowerblue and must be overridden.
learned_contract.layout: Six species in shared row order; two wide chromosome panels stacked; bp converted to Mb consistently; annotations on sequence baselines, separate categorical legends at right.
migration_checks: Never relabel an alignment gap as confirmed sequence absence.
Record alignment filtering; repeated segments may have low mapq.
PAF is 0-based half-open, GRanges generally 1-based closed; make conversion explicit.
Fix order and coordinate conventions; no independent panel sorting.

entries.claim_boundary: Source/code/visual study is reusable guidance; new-input rendering and final-size review are required.

learned_contract.data_contract: Locus PAF with strand and saved genomic bounds; query and target gene/SD GRanges; block definitions. Experimental images and ancestral-event models are separate source materials.
learned_contract.code_binding: SVbyEye API/implementation transfer; no final paper-specific assembly script verified.
learned_contract.preplot: Subset the same biological locus in both assemblies; paf2coords handles minus-strand endpoints and a continuous scale, optionally synchronizes query x coordinates. addAnnotation distinguishes target/query/self spaces and translates query annotations.
learned_contract.palette: Fig.3 uses pale blue background alignments, yellow inversion and colored blocks shared between alignment and model. Exact final palette/driver unavailable; source defaults are not publication values.
learned_contract.layout: Wide alignment plus slim gene/probe tracks; FISH panel at right; transformation model below. Local plots and schematics retain their own coordinate semantics.
migration_checks: Preserve original query and target coordinates alongside plotting transforms.
Synchronizing display x coordinates does not create a genomic lift-over map.
Probe/centromere labels require actual coordinates, not arbitrary marks.
Do not turn observed alignment patterns into a proven evolutionary event sequence.

entries.claim_boundary: Source/code/visual study is reusable guidance; new-input rendering and final-size review are required.

learned_contract.published_reference: Fig.7b,c (StainedGlass, 2-kb bins); Fig.5a explicitly uses ModDotPlot, whose code was not audited here.
learned_contract.data_contract: StainedGlass processed paired intervals: #query_name/query_start/query_end/reference_name/reference_start/reference_end/perID_by_events/strand. Genomic annotations and methylation tables are additional inputs.
learned_contract.code_binding: Fig.7 caption explicitly names StainedGlass. Current tool pipeline/plotting code reviewed; article-specific parameter file and final composite not found.
learned_contract.preplot: refmt sorts by matches, keeps one best hit per query/reference window pair, mirrors intervals and deduplicates. perID_by_events=100*matches/(matches+mismatches+insertion_events+deletion_events). Triangle rotates bin positions with w=first+second, z=-first+second, then builds diamond polygons.
learned_contract.palette: Tool uses reversed Spectral. get_colors uses quantile breaks, not fixed identity percent thresholds. ONECOLORSCALE controls global vs per-sequence coloring; raw percent values must be retained and displayed accurately.
learned_contract.layout: Triangle with identity histogram inset; repeat architecture and spacer composition below; methylation line plus SD band aligned to spacer midpoint. make_plots uses annotation_custom or cowplot for histogram only; full methylation/annotation composite is not in this script.
migration_checks: Use common fixed identity breaks when comparing loci/species; do not label quantile classes as fixed percentages.
Match histogram fill and heatmap fill to the same breaks.
The histogram display starts at the 0.1% identity quantile; disclose view truncation.
Leave unaligned cells blank instead of inserting zero identity.
Keep 2-kb binning distinct from pixel resolution.

entries.claim_boundary: Source/code/visual study is reusable guidance; new-input rendering and final-size review are required.

learned_contract.published_reference: Author repository divergence diagnostic/supplementary context; exact published panel not bound.
learned_contract.data_contract: Author interspecies/intraspecies divergence CSVs: NAME, CHRGRP A/X/Y, BIN_SIZE, DIFF, GAP_OTHER, DIV. Preserve directed reference/other comparison; SNV and GAP rows are duplicated views of each window.
learned_contract.preplot: Compute window missing-state fractions separately; code DIFF is mismatches/(matches+mismatches), conditional on aligned nucleotides, while GAP_OTHER is missing-other positions/all window positions. Expand each window into SNV/GAP rows; set fixed species/metric factor order.
learned_contract.palette: Source color order A/X/Y = #673AB7/#D55E00/#0072B2; migrate as a NAMED vector rather than relying on factor order.
learned_contract.layout: Vertical metric/species facets, overlaid A/X/Y densities; fixed bw=0.01, interspecies mean marks and autosomal within-species dashed mean. Source exports 7 x 7 inch PDF; this is not a verified final Nature page layout.
migration_checks: stage_data_part2.R contains an executable exit() before source/read processing; not a ready-to-run driver.
Source roundMe ignores its numbers argument and rounds to 4 decimals.
Terminal bins are shorter; distinguish equal-window means from base-weighted means.
Large Y peaks may reflect few windows; window counts do not equal biological n.
NA is not zero; A-vs-B and B-vs-A have different reference denominators.

learned_contract.data_contract: Shared reference assembly and locus; genomic annotation intervals, sequence-class or mapping windows, and methylation mean/SD with the original aggregation unit. For paired loci, preserve distinct query/target coordinates.
learned_contract.code_binding: Published layout/legend observation; article-specific track/composite code not found in the three audited snapshots. Do not present this recipe as executable reproduction.
learned_contract.palette: Separate sequence-class colors from identity gradient and methylation blue; Fig.5d uses explicit multi-mapper/no-mapping classes. Methylation line+SD band comes from Fig.7 caption; band must not be relabeled CI.
learned_contract.layout: Shared locus ticks and vertical alignment; categorical annotations as thin horizontal tracks; orthologue self/paired heatmaps around a common square; species/haplotype order fixed. Fig.6a shares an Mb scale across centromere small multiples, with CDR diamonds.
migration_checks: No mapping, multi-mapping and unique mapping remain separate states.
Do not independently normalize the physical width of each centromere when comparing array lengths.
CpG percentages and fractions cannot share an unlabeled scale.
Tracks require chromosome ID, orientation and coordinate-conversion records.
Printed final-size alignment and labels remain unverified until rendered.

entries.claim_boundary: Source/code/visual study is reusable guidance; new-input rendering and final-size review are required.

learned_contract.scope: One genomics case: source learning, published-image review and bounded derived-table checks; no raw-read pipeline, no figure reproduction.

figures.caption: Distribution of variation on chromosome 1. a , WGA illustrates that the genomes are structurally conserved away from centromeric regions. Chromosomes are aligned from both ends to emphasize the contiguity of the arms, with the unassembled centromeric regions indicated in yellow and inversions in pink. Oscillating gray shades highlight homologous regions (the periodicity of the gradients reflects repeated use of the color scheme and has no biological meaning).  b , The density of pangenome graph bubbles, reflecting higher diversity in pericentromeric regions and at ~20 Mb, where an ancestral centromere was lost through chromosome fusion 41 . Synteny level refers to the average sharing of links between nodes across the 27 genomes in 300-kb blocks.  c , Distribution of nucleotide diversity based on SNPs called from a multiple alignment. Blue dots represent values of diversity in 200-kb windows. The red line is a smoothed fit to these points, with the standard error shown. The dark blue area corresponds to the centromeric region, with the lighter blue area highlighting the pericentromeric area and the lightest blue the ancestral lost centromere 41 . For chromosomes 2–5, see Extended Data Fig.  1 .
figures.visual_review: opened published publisher image; layout/palette observations stored in plot_recipes

figures.caption: The allele frequency distribution of SVs. a , The frequency distribution of the presence alleles of all sSVs grouped by variant length (in bp). The height of the gray block (left) is equivalent to the height of the complete panel (right).  b , The proportion of length classes of sSVs in each frequency bin. Colors correspond to those in  a .
figures.visual_review: opened published publisher image; layout/palette observations stored in plot_recipes

figures.caption: The role of TEs in bi-allelic indels. a , Categories of overlap between the presence allele of sSVs and annotated TE sequences.  b , Number of sSVs in each TE-content category described in  a . Colors correspond to  a —gray, no TE content.  c , d , Histograms of presence frequency showing annotated TE content as a function of frequency, either raw counts ( c ) or relative to TE-related SVs ( d ).  e , Distribution of the length of presence alleles in different categories. For an analysis broken down by TE superfamily (Supplementary Fig.  12 ).
figures.visual_review: opened published publisher image; layout/palette observations stored in plot_recipes

figures.caption: The graph structure of sSVs. a , The number of sSVs included (or not) in the graph of nestedness as a function of TE content.  b , Graph illustrating the nestedness of sSVs, including only presence alleles with nonzero TE content. Each node represents a set of mutually nested sequences, using a similarity threshold of 0.85, with node size reflecting the number of included sequences. Nodes are colored by TE content as shown in  a .  c , Same graph as in  b , but colored by TE superfamilies, as shown in the center on top. Note that the algorithm used no prior knowledge of TE superfamilies. A large, dominant component connecting all TE superfamilies is also seen in a graph built using the entire  A. thaliana  TE annotation, suggesting that our sSVs and the reference annotation have comparable properties (Extended Data Fig.  4 ).  d , A graph of nestedness for sSVs without TE content, colored by open reading frame content based on protein BLAST, as shown on the right.
figures.visual_review: opened published publisher image; layout/palette observations stored in plot_recipes

figures.caption: The growth of the pangenome. a , The dependence on sample size for the union (‘pan’) and intersection (‘core’) sequence length, separately for the full genome, the mobile-ome and the gene-ome (for saturation by sSV length and normalized views, see Extended Data Fig.  7 ).  b , Pangenome versus reference genome coordinates. The pericentromeric region (light blue) shows a higher ‘dilution’ of the spatial coordinates due to the increased number of SVs in this region, but please note that the slope is never 1, reflecting their ubiquity. The centromeric region is dark blue (for other chromosomes, see Extended Data Fig.  7 ).  c , The contribution of sSVs of different lengths to differences between pairs of genomes. Numbers are counts of sSVs. Shorter sSVs are more numerous, but longer and rarer sSVs contribute more to total length variation.
figures.visual_review: opened published publisher image; layout/palette observations stored in plot_recipes

figures.caption: Read mapping and reference bias. a , To investigate SNP-calling errors, SNPs were identified from pairwise WGA as well as by designating one genome as a reference and calling SNPs using short reads from the other (next generation sequencing (NGS); see Supplementary Note  7  for details). Numbers are averages across all accession pairs (±s.d.). From the point of view of WGA, each site can either be aligned or not. Conversely, from the point of view of NGS, each site in the reference genome can be covered by sample reads or not. Arrows pointing right refer to WGA SNPs, which we assume to be correct; arrows pointing left refer to NGS SNPs. WGA SNPs are TPs if also called by NGS, FNs if missed by NGS and uncalled if in regions not covered by NGS reads. Conversely, NGS SNPs are TPs if also found in the WGA and FPs if not. FPs come in two flavors: those that correspond to bona fide non-SNPs in the WGA and those that correspond to regions that were not aligned. Heterozygous calls in completely inbred lines are obviously FPs and are treated separately.  b , SNP-calling error rates depend on the relationship between the reference and the sampled genome. Each line is the regression of SNP-calling errors for a different choice of reference genome (identified by color). FNR, false negative rate.  c , Correlation between expression- and methylation-level estimates derived from mapping reads to the TAIR10 genome and the genome of the sampled individual. Sample sizes for each data type also apply to  d  and  e .  d , Percentage of genes for which expression or methylation levels differ by more than 30% or 50%, respectively, when mapping reads to the TAIR10 reference rather than their ‘own’ genome.  e , Enrichment of copy-number variable genes among those with discordant expression- or methylation-level estimates. Box plots show the median plus the 25th and 75th percentiles, with whiskers covering the smallest and largest values within 1.5× the interquartile range. The percentage of copy-number variable (CNV) genes was compared between wrongly and correctly estimated genes across available samples using a two-sided Wilcoxon test. TPs, true positives; FPs, false positives; FNs, false negatives.

learned_contract.chart: 多基因组带状共线性/倒位
data_contract: accession顺序、chr长度、centromere端点；坐标为基因组位置而非表达矩阵
preplot_processing: extractBlocks识别共核区断点；过滤短块；prepareBlocks按染色体两臂调整坐标

palette.meaning: 周期灰色仅帮助对应区段，无生物量意义；色向须核对dir逻辑，不凭亮暗解释相似度

layout_and_export: 27 accession+参考行；共同row order；chr两端对齐，中间缺口保留
作者7×5英寸PDF；出版组合图另组装；用户转绘需终尺寸核验
reproduction_gaps: blocks_all_v02.rds已保存可复核；val_common_chr_*_ref_add.rds、cen_pos_fernando.txt、chr_len.txt未在固定树中提供。

热图、共线性共享accession顺序；π轨道采用自身物理位置，不能把热图离散列索引误作bp
layout_and_export: 热图位于共线性下方，横向色条移数据区外；π作为短底轨，共享可比较区间
作者热图7×4.5英寸，π7×1.2英寸PDF；出版图π为蓝点＋红平滑＋SE带
reproduction_gaps: bubbles表、centromere辅助表未提供；脚本未显式绑定chr.order，迁移须锁row levels
公开π输入和旧脚本为300kb、geom_line；出版caption为200kb蓝点红平滑，不能宣称完全对应；最终平滑代码未定位

learned_contract.chart: SV长度分箱频谱＋频率内组成
preplot_processing: table(len.gr,freq.max)，折线绘绝对数；组成图按每个频率列归一化，列和=1
len>=15与len>15在不同段出现，实际重绘必须明确边界

palette.mapping: 按levels命名；先确定分箱数再插值；两面板同bin同色

layout_and_export: 低长度组单独窄面板，灰色矩形标示右侧完整面板量级；不能解读为置信区间
右侧100%组成小图，不以其高度同绝对数比较；作者频谱7×3、组成3.5×2.7英寸PDF
迁移柱图按用户偏好加细描边；密集堆叠避免粗黑边遮色
reproduction_gaps: sv_se.rds未提供；成图最终嵌入排版未见完整driver

learned_contract.chart: SV嵌套网络：整体＝最大分量＋其余分量
data_contract: BLAST命中→nestedness表：序列IDs、方向、覆盖度、相似度
节点collapsed sequence成员数、TE类别/超家族/蛋白注释；边是嵌套关系，不是表达相关
preplot_processing: self hits移除，sim.cutoff=0.85；getGraphFromBlast collapse=TRUE合并互相嵌套组
traitsSeqToNode汇总type/fam；节点大小cnt；getGraphComponents分离最大连通分量
TE整体/分量对照seed=20；noTE图seed=239；保存坐标以免包版本改变布局
layout_and_export: 出版b、c两行同图换色，整体/最大/其余并排，等号加号留独立槽；类别图例置中空隙
主图seed20默认ggnet2布局，最大分量显式kamadakawai；非所有图均kamadakawai
作者单网络4.6×4.6英寸PDF；最终版等号、图例及环形插图组装未定位
reproduction_gaps: sv_se.rds、BLAST与nestedness缓存缺失；源引用外部pannagram旧目录函数，版本未在论文仓库锁定
noTE公开片段collapse=FALSE/node.size=1，不能直接复现出版d的全部节点含义
seed不跨环境保证坐标；换色比较应显式复用layout矩阵，不重新求图

learned_contract.chart: Pan/Core镜像增长曲线＋端点标注
data_contract: 基因presence/loci长度、sSV binary×accession矩阵和长度、全基因组alignment矩阵
preplot_processing: 样本量2:27，无放回子集；代码每量20次sample未去重复，不等同论文方法所述20个独特组合
pan取union、core取intersection，先算绝对长度再按n=2均值设变化基线
stat_summary(mean)画线；端点标签仍表示init绝对值；lm(value~n.acc+log(n.acc))保留默认截距
layout_and_export: 上下pan/core自由y尺度+自由高度，共享n轴；端点文字同source颜色，a/b公式黑色
作者5×4英寸PDF；Core变化负值，不能将镜像方向解释为原始负长度
命名fitPowerLaw不能替代看公式：实际不是幂律拟合
reproduction_gaps: presence、长度、HDF5 alignment与统计输入未提供；随机子集抽样段未设seed，应迁移时指定并保存子集
共享accession子集有依赖，不能把n.rep当生物重复或据此直接做ANOVA

learned_contract.chart: SV长度类别累计长度的透明点簇＋计数标注
data_contract: 各染色体pairwise长度组的count、mean length表；每点为共享accession的基因组对
preplot_processing: cnt×mean.len得到y.tot累计长度；按长度类别汇总平均count用于上方标签
基因组对共享成员，因此点之间有依赖；类别离散x，连续长度log10 y

palette.mapping: 作者cols命名长度组，必须按脚本分箱和levels建立后复用；出版图浅黄→绿→棕→紫→粉

layout_and_export: 低alpha=0.2、width=0.3；黑色计数文本放点簇上方；旋转较长bin标签
作者5×4英寸PDF；迁移jitter锁seed，信息注释不遮点
reproduction_gaps: pairwise计数/均长表未提供；未运行点簇重绘

data_contract: 每点为测序样本/甲基化accession；重复组织与batch不自动独立；gene为指标分母而非n
preplot_processing: 排除参考6909；组织S/R/F/P；错估%=wrong/(wrong+good)×100
CNV_wrong与CNV_good分别使用各自分母；未匹配CNV注释不补作nonCNV
表达代码以max≥6、min/max≤0.70分错估；甲基化percentchange>50；出版caption边界要分别保留

palette.transfer: 原始红绿对照色义固定；色盲替代方案需作为明确变体，不声称原色

layout_and_export: 出版c/d/e横向排，组织顺序和expression/methylation间隔对齐；各面板范围各自清楚
源为纵向base boxplot+stripchart，出版旋转成横向；dummy -1/-10只作空档，不是生物观测，转绘须移除显式layout留空
作者相关图4×3.5英寸PDF；CNV6×3.5英寸；出版边框/旋转最终组装未定位
reproduction_gaps: 可用小表，重算panel指标与检验；表达/甲基化全矩阵未取得，不能核验upstream全量预处理
公开脚本硬编码Z:/与HPC路径，且依赖import_data全局对象；不直接整段运行
wilcox.test默认paired=FALSE：作者检验原样记录，迁移先询问配对/独立/批次意向；七组比较考虑多重校正
flexible_wilcox只检查组内ties，跨组ties亦需检查；不复用为通用统计封装
两份Fig6/8主R脚本全文解析失败：绘图脚本2942行裸Z:/路径；import脚本77行裸输出。保留作者原件，仅独立重算小表指标；不宣称作者全文可运行。

published_figures_reviewed.label: Fig. 3
published_figures_reviewed.caption: Comparative gene expression and gene network analyses.a, Illustration of the six main communities identified in the WGCNA analysis. Module–tissue correlation and functional enrichment of the modules included in each of the communities reveal distinct associations with tissues/organs. C1–C3, plant reproductive processes; C4, photosynthesis—shoot; C5, starch metabolism—caryopsis and C6, nutrient uptake—root. b, Distribution of 1:1 orthologous groups (exactly 20 genes, 1 from each genotype) across the six communities. Number of accessions refers to the largest cluster within a single community for the respective orthogroup. c, Major functional enrichments where the color of the dot represents the FDR-adjusted P value of one-sided Fisher’s exact test (top), and the module-tissue PCC where the size of the dot represents the P value of two-sided Fisher’s exact test (bottom) for the six main communities. d, Accession-specific co-expression distribution of selected barley orthogroups (y axis) associated with distinct functions based on orthology to rice (panel 1, MADS-box protein family; panels 2–4, families discussed in the text) over the six communities and corresponding genotypes (x axis). PCC, Pearson correlation coefficients.
published_figures_reviewed.inspection: Original image opened and compared with fixed source code on 2026-10-02; no local rerender.

published_figures_reviewed.label: Extended Data Fig. 4
published_figures_reviewed.caption: Transcription factor binding site analysis.a, Percent identities for transcription factor binding sites (TFBS) in 500 bp segments of 2 kb upstream (regions from A to D) and 500 bp downstream (region E) of start codon computed for each genotype vs. Morex. The x axis indicates 30 TFBS consensus sequences with a code from 1 to 30 (see Methods for details). b, Percent TFBS identities against percent coherent expression in each pairwise comparison (individual genotypes vs. Morex, each pair represented by a dot) for all genes (15,001 genes Pearson correlation value = 0.395), genes with low coefficient of variation (CV; 0–0.4 CV, 2,999 genes, corr. = 0.695) and genes with high CV (1.48–20 CV, 2,994 genes, corr. = 0.087).
published_figures_reviewed.inspection: Original image opened and compared with fixed source code on 2026-10-02; no local rerender.

published_figures_reviewed.label: Extended Data Fig. 5
published_figures_reviewed.caption: Community clustering.a, Full distribution of 1:1 orthologous groups (exactly 20 genes, one from each genotype) across the six communities. Number of accessions refers to the largest cluster within a single community for the respective orthogroup. b, Heatmap displaying the Louvain community clustering of all 738 WGCNA modules (bottom). Six main communities were identified (x axis C1–C6), which show distinct functional patterns where the color of the dot represents the false discovery rate (FDR) adjusted p value of one-sided Fisher’s exact test (top) and module-tissue correlations where the size of the dot represents the p value of two-sided Fisher’s exact test (middle). c, The 861 transcription factors presence–absence clustering representation across the six communities.

plot_recipes.name: 跨基因型模块社区网络与边束布局
plot_recipes.chart_selection: 输入是模块—基因集合、模块间相似度；突出群间共享结构，选社区网络。节点是模块，不是样本或基因。
data_processing: 按module_name聚合ID为set，节点大小取模块基因数；同一基因多条功能注释不得重复计数。
保留0.07≤cosine<1的边，排除孤立点；Louvain resolution=1, seed=108，按社区节点数降序命名。
Data9可提供已发表738模块及C1–C6归属；应保留作者归属，不把重新聚类的任意标签当作同一C编号。

color_mapping.source: 06 script lines95–102; published Fig3a consistent; icons not generated here.

layout_implementation: Netgraph Graph(node_layout="community", node_to_community=partition)，edge_layout="bundled", k=2000。
节点半径经min–max映射0.5–3；node_edge_width=.07，edge_width=.2；边宽固定，不编码权重。
10×8英寸、代理Line2D句柄制作独立社区图例。原图外围器官图标、引线和最终拼版属于发表后组装，源码无对应对象。
reproduction_gaps: 06第64行遍历整数community_id，触发TypeError；第67行pd未导入。迁移应使用node/community对应表，作者原文件保留。

六社区色表仅覆盖六类；更多社区需扩充。固定版本也不能保证布局坐标完全相同，需保存坐标/种子。

plot_recipes.name: 模块集合相似度聚类热图
plot_recipes.chart_selection: 比较多个基因型模块的共享程度，使用对称相似度矩阵热图；需要块结构时按社区排序并对齐上方点阵。
data_processing: Jaccard=交集/并集；二元基因集合cosine=交集/sqrt(|A||B|)。word2vec传入的是完整基因ID列表，非字符序列。
itertools.product包含双向和对角线；矩阵行列同一module_names顺序。输出四位小数。
发表ED5b以社区对齐点阵—相关点阵—738×738热图；ED6选C5/C6/C4的最连接模块，图注cosine阈值.43，非网络构图阈值.07。

color_mapping.published_observation: 蓝色顺序色标0–1；作者mako_r中间图与发表终稿颜色不同，不宣称完全一致。

layout_implementation: clustermap(method="average", figsize=(11,10), dendrogram_ratio=(.05,.05))，隐藏密集行列标签；色条手动定位[.95,.2,.015,.3]。
原码每20项画白色分隔线，仅为固定排版；迁移应由真实分组边界计算。
发表图观察：ED5b社区顺序C6,C2,C4,C3,C1,C5；ED6列C5,C6,C4，纵轴模块顺序与顶部点阵共享。
reproduction_gaps: 源码提供基础矩阵绘图，未提供发表图的社区重排序、最连接模块挑选及三层终稿组装。
cosine/jaccard名称中distance为注释误称；函数返回similarity。
空集合须防除零；稠密矩阵需要量级评估、固定vmin/vmax=0/1。

plot_recipes.name: 功能富集—模块组织相关双层点阵
plot_recipes.chart_selection: 输入是module×tissue相关系数与P、module×term富集结果；上层功能、下层组织共享模块横坐标，用颜色/点面积分别编码量值。
data_processing: 组织level-vs-all二值编码，与模块eigengene（PC1）计算Pearson r；生成module/tissue/r/P长表。
功能富集TERM2GENE按Mercator层级分开，enricher(BH,pvalueCutoff=.05,minGSSize=10,maxGSSize=500,qvalueCutoff=.2)。
源码pf_conv与每基因converted_ort_mod内连接，会重复每模块×组织点；绘图前按module/tissue去重，统计用实际sample数。

模块按accession内大小排序，行因素与标签显式命名，不能依赖列的偶然位置。
避免重复点、过大点及默认巨大字体；最终尺寸重新设置，发表两层点阵纵轴高度不同。

learned_contract.name: 跨基因型模块社区网络与边束布局
learned_contract.chart_selection: 输入是模块—基因集合、模块间相似度；突出群间共享结构，选社区网络。节点是模块，不是样本或基因。
data_processing: 按module_name聚合ID为set，节点大小取模块基因数；同一基因多条功能注释不得重复计数。
保留0.07≤cosine<1的边，排除孤立点；Louvain resolution=1, seed=108，按社区节点数降序命名。
Data9可提供已发表738模块及C1–C6归属；应保留作者归属，不把重新聚类的任意标签当作同一C编号。

color_mapping.source: 06 script lines95–102; published Fig3a consistent; icons not generated here.

layout_implementation: Netgraph Graph(node_layout="community", node_to_community=partition)，edge_layout="bundled", k=2000。
节点半径经min–max映射0.5–3；node_edge_width=.07，edge_width=.2；边宽固定，不编码权重。
10×8英寸、代理Line2D句柄制作独立社区图例。原图外围器官图标、引线和最终拼版属于发表后组装，源码无对应对象。
reproduction_gaps: 06第64行遍历整数community_id，触发TypeError；第67行pd未导入。迁移应使用node/community对应表，作者原文件保留。
rescale_dict_values遇到等值大小除零；需要显式保护。
六社区色表仅覆盖六类；更多社区需扩充。固定版本也不能保证布局坐标完全相同，需保存坐标/种子。

learned_contract.name: 模块集合相似度聚类热图
learned_contract.chart_selection: 比较多个基因型模块的共享程度，使用对称相似度矩阵热图；需要块结构时按社区排序并对齐上方点阵。
data_processing: Jaccard=交集/并集；二元基因集合cosine=交集/sqrt(|A||B|)。word2vec传入的是完整基因ID列表，非字符序列。
itertools.product包含双向和对角线；矩阵行列同一module_names顺序。输出四位小数。
发表ED5b以社区对齐点阵—相关点阵—738×738热图；ED6选C5/C6/C4的最连接模块，图注cosine阈值.43，非网络构图阈值.07。

color_mapping.published_observation: 蓝色顺序色标0–1；作者mako_r中间图与发表终稿颜色不同，不宣称完全一致。

layout_implementation: clustermap(method="average", figsize=(11,10), dendrogram_ratio=(.05,.05))，隐藏密集行列标签；色条手动定位[.95,.2,.015,.3]。
原码每20项画白色分隔线，仅为固定排版；迁移应由真实分组边界计算。
发表图观察：ED5b社区顺序C6,C2,C4,C3,C1,C5；ED6列C5,C6,C4，纵轴模块顺序与顶部点阵共享。
reproduction_gaps: 源码提供基础矩阵绘图，未提供发表图的社区重排序、最连接模块挑选及三层终稿组装。
cosine/jaccard名称中distance为注释误称；函数返回similarity。
空集合须防除零；稠密矩阵需要量级评估、固定vmin/vmax=0/1。

entries.claim_boundary: Source/code/visual study is reusable guidance; new-input rendering and final-size review are required.

learned_contract.name: 启动子分区×motif 五列线图
learned_contract.chart_selection: 相同30个TFBS在多个区域/基因型的身份比例，按区域分面、基因型颜色统一，显示空间梯度。
data_processing: 读作者TFBS统计Excel，CONDITION=ALL_GENES，去掉REGION F；A–D为起始密码子上游四个500bp，E为下游500bp。
源码筛五个基因型，as.numeric(as.factor(CIS_ELEM_name))为x；迁移须保留30motif正式顺序与名称映射，不能默认字母顺序。

color_mapping.published_observation: 原图显示Morex之外19基因型，多色色条图例在下方；五色源码与发表19色不同。

layout_implementation: facet_wrap五列，公用y轴10–100，浅灰背景，去网格，x竖排每隔一项标刻度。
命名manual palette绑定基因型；发表图共享图例放分面下方，避免遮挡曲线。

export.source: 组合图18×11.5cm PNG900dpi（109行）；未来PDF需重新实现矢量导出。

reproduction_gaps: 源码五基因型与原图19基因型不一致，不能直接宣称原图复现。
三份指定统计Excel未在公开仓库/本次补表中找到；TFBS分析脚本有ARBITRARY_PATH及未补全路径。

entries.claim_boundary: Source/code/visual study is reusable guidance; new-input rendering and final-size review are required.

learned_contract.name: TFBS身份—表达一致性散点与非对称组合布局
learned_contract.chart_selection: 两项比例针对同一Morex—基因型对，使用散点+按基因集合分层的回归线；点是基因型比较，不是独立基因复制。
data_processing: 上游A–D汇总30motif身份比例；表达一致性是Morex均值/对应基因型均值落在[.7,1.3]的基因比例。
百分数除100并用percent_format显示；gene_Set分层，散点geom_smooth(lm,se=FALSE)。
零表达分母、缺值与同一参考Morex造成的相关依赖均需明确；直线不代表因果关系。

color_mapping.code: p2默认离散颜色，p3另设9个半透明NPG风格hex。
color_mapping.published_observation: 低CV绿、全基因红、高CV蓝；该3类配色不来自p2命名palette。

layout_implementation: 源码grid.arrange 5×5：顶部p1占3整行，底部左p2占2列、右p3占3列；cowplot三标签坐标[0,0,.42]×[1,.42,.42]。
发表仅a/b两个面板：顶部五分面，下方左共享基因型图例、右散点与外侧集合图例；作者p3未出现在最终ED4。

export.source: ggsave18×11.5cm白底PNG900dpi；5pt作者组合字体不能直接当投稿终尺寸标准。

reproduction_gaps: 图注报告的r=.395/.695/.087本次没有完整输入，未复算。
公开TFBS分析R含空赋值/占位路径，语法解析通过；空赋值可能跨行串联，仍缺有效输入/路径，不能据此声称可运行。
源版本含第三个CV集合线图，未匹配发表版；需要另做终稿组装。

learned_contract.name: 组织命名配色与PCA/UMAP诊断组合
learned_contract.chart_selection: 已经合理变换的sample×gene矩阵，探索样本分离，使用PCA/UMAP并由metadata明确组织色/形；不把嵌入图替代正式组间检验。
data_processing: 按ID连接表达矩阵与metadata，组织、批次、基因型为qualitative supplementary variables；PCA scale.unit=FALSE。
UMAP n_neighbors=13为此项目选择，不能替代数据自适应参数检查。
源码02将已VST浮点数再as.integer，会损失精度；迁移保留浮点变换矩阵，保证输入与metadata同顺序。

color_mapping.scope: 作者诊断图，不等同于正文Fig1b的MDS方法。

layout_implementation: patchwork：(UMAP+scree)/(PC1–2+PC3–4)，显式保留共同组织色、形与图例。
全样本notebook按两列三行组PCA；存储输出为作者旧会话结果，需重新运行才可用。

export.source: 作者PNG32×20英寸；巨幅中间图字体25–32pt，移植必须缩至交付尺寸并重新QA。

reproduction_gaps: 正文为MDS，作者PCA/UMAP作为诊断辅助，不声称直接生成正文图。
notebook保存fviz_eig找不到函数的历史错误与其他残留图；不能把嵌入输出当连贯可执行证据。

entries.claim_boundary: Source/code/visual study is reusable guidance; new-input rendering and final-size review are required.

plot_recipes.chart: 双单倍型染色体共线性多边形＋CpG宽度/基因密度双编码轨道＋位点矩形
plot_recipes.when: 同一物种相位组装的同向/倒位区块、窗口CpG及基因数、关键基因座；需要在基因组位置上同时比较结构与密度。
input_contract: 指定EH23a/b的染色体长度、1..9,X顺序；bp坐标转Mb仅用于轴标签。
SyRI区块ref/query chromosome/start/end与SYN/INV类别；禁止用任意随机连线替代对齐拓扑。
1Mb原生窗口为Start=0,End=999999,Win_length=1000000；为0基闭区间式，不能直接当BED半开输入。
GFF基因坐标与BLAST位点记录须确认基准/方向；EH23b chr4/5/8/X已作者翻转。
author RData及4组exact source plot_data提供已处理绘图层；新数据仍须重新处理与QC。
processing: 先选SYN/INV，源脚本按ref/query相邻间距<400kb合并SYN；合并顺序必须验证，不能盲目套阈值。
gribbon取每个block的上下界，10点logistic插值，每块20 polygon顶点；invert交换query_start/query_end；chrX编号10，双单倍型x偏移±0.2。
CpG%=CG/Win_length×100，每条chr先平移到0再除其max，iCGs=1-CGs；rect宽度映射iCGs，因此是chr内相对CpG尺度。
get_wins中间阶段按各assembly独立min-max生成gcntsc与临时颜色（Rmd318–320）；最终绘图前Rmd450–477覆盖gcol，两个haplotype共同max(gcnt)=156，颜色索引as.integer(gcnt/shared_max*99+1)，100色magma(begin=.1,end=.9)。迁移时保持共同尺度；共同max为0须显式处理。
原脚本基因归窗要求V4>=Start,V5<End，属于完整包含规则；跨窗口基因不应被默认为start-bin。
精确保留pEH23中的SYN/INV顶点、1487窗口和marker值；不是重跑SyRI/GFF生成。

ggpubr: ggarrange in old Ideo_plot combined panels, final publication assembly not supplied
packages_by_role.SyRI: upstream event classification only, not rerun

palette.gene_density: 100-level magma(.1,.9), shared EH23a/b max156; as.integer(gcnt/shared_max*99+1); 88 realized colours. Per-assembly gcntsc is intermediate only.

layout: 两haploidy中心±.2、细柱chrom_wid=.05，外侧条thinw=.28；灰SYN先铺底、橙INV覆上、热色窗和marker后画。
沿共同Mb轴、各chr保持真实长度；色条随主图区，独立标genes per1Mb，宽度不复用gene色标。
原Ideo_plot有6.5×6.5in导出注释及2:1纵向ggarrange旧版；不能当当前Nature终稿尺寸合同。

plot_recipes.source_legacy_locator: SexChromosomes/README.md says Fig2/ED2; final official panel is ED9c/d, verified by XML and original image.
plot_recipes.chart: X/Y基因位置–性别平均表达差散点＋上侧频数step＋右侧逆累积分布
plot_recipes.when: 已经取得同一参考chr、gene start、male/female average TPM与synteny category，需要显示位置聚集及表达差分布；不是差异检验。
input_contract: 11列TSV:labelID,geneID,start,stop,syntenyID,femaleID,femaleAvgTPM,maleID,maleAvgTPM,tpmDiff,annotation。
geneID保留assembly.chr.gene原键；花/叶、sex、replicate元数据先匹配后按组算平均，零表达保留。
仅给均值TSV时只能描述；不得把每个基因或marker点当生物重复。
flower_male_biased_expression.txt由male_only与male_higher_exp_min5TPM_diffs拼接；缺原输入就保留missing，不能模拟替代原值。
processing: 作者按sex/tissue选所有replicate，以算术mean TPM保留零值；bias用abs(mean_male-mean_female)>=5TPM，exclusive用另一sex零表达。
minimum avgTPM意图为1；源码exclusive分支使用>threshold，而原图注写>=1，临界1需单独审。
y=log2(mean_maleTPM+1)-log2(mean_femaleTPM+1)，不是log2TPM差无伪计数，也不是DESeq2效应。
x=start/1e6；分synteny类别散点alpha=.5；上侧每1Mb频数，右侧每.5单位逆累计density分布。
右侧cumulative=-1且density=True为每类别归一累计概率，不是频数；不能与顶部频数混用单位。
layout: joint gs[1:4,0:3]、top gs[0,0:3]、right gs[1:4,3]；共用位置/表达range并隐藏重复轴标。
X与Y保持真实chr长度，不强行截到相同max；类别顺序与图例语义共同锁定。
新图将图例移入专属留白带、对齐上下边缘，避免原图大图例遮点；未来若画计数柱加用户要求薄深色描边。
gaps: 作者README给的S3 female_vs_male_all_average_exp.txt HTTP403，原gene输入未取得，数值及渲染not_run。
np.arange(min,max,step)不包含最大端点，最右点可被hist漏掉；新输入bin edges须延长到>=max并核对hist sum=n。
absTPM>1与caption>=1边界、内部sample名按位置split的脆弱性及缺sex键都须核验。
代码旧图号不代表正式原图号；TE ED9e/f由另代码处理，本包不以gene源码假绑定。
plot_recipes.statistics: 作者阈值型表达分类；无统计P值。需推断时先询问比较意向及实验单位、配对与重复，再选count-based合适模型；不自动追加gene-wise t test。
plot_recipes.question: 大麻 cannabis X/Y 性染色体表达位置 scatter 散点与联合边际直方图 joint histogram 如何对齐？

visual_observations: 10染色体对同一Mb轴；窄灰染色体、外侧CpG宽度条＋magma基因密度、灰SYN/橙INV多边形、绿/红/黑位点标记。
Fig1a占左上大块，原连续色条紧随右侧；整页曲线、嵌入、树和基因汇总分区，字体不是固定模板。
图内f为MDS、g为树，但官方caption将f/g反写；本包只绑定a，不自动移植标签。
c/d分别X/Y：中间位置散点，上侧频数step，右侧逆累积分布，3:1图区分配；X与Y横轴长度不同。
PAR蓝、X专属红、SDR橙、非共线黑，散点半透明；c/d上方图例面积大，会遮住高值点，迁移时另留图例带。
e/f为TE表达版本，不能把gene脚本称为TE面板源码；本包不绑定e/f。

source_discrepancies: Official Fig1 caption f=hierarchical/g=MDS, original image f=MDS/g=tree; retained as mismatch, outside selected a binding.
SexChromosomes README old Fig2/ED2 → formal ED9c/d; verified by official Fig14.
ED9 caption omits +1, source explicitly uses log2(TPM+1).
ED9 exclusive expression minimum caption>=1 vs source strict>threshold in branch; do not silently migrate.
get_wins assembly-specific min-max gcntsc is overwritten by final shared EH23a/b max156 colour scale at Rmd450–477; migration follows final gcol, not intermediate gcntsc.

SequenceEntropy: readEntropyFile requires unique mean entropy per OG/population and minimum protein count≥5; duplicate discrepant entropy aborts.
jointHistogram pairs shared OG keys, blue other OGs/red TE groups, alpha=.1, common x/y max1.1×max, Pearsonr and polyfit.
Processed entropy tables not fetched and exact final panel not bound; learning only, no indexed high-fidelity recipe.

learned_contract.chart: 双单倍型染色体共线性多边形＋CpG宽度/基因密度双编码轨道＋位点矩形
learned_contract.when: 同一物种相位组装的同向/倒位区块、窗口CpG及基因数、关键基因座；需要在基因组位置上同时比较结构与密度。
input_contract: 指定EH23a/b的染色体长度、1..9,X顺序；bp坐标转Mb仅用于轴标签。
SyRI区块ref/query chromosome/start/end与SYN/INV类别；禁止用任意随机连线替代对齐拓扑。
1Mb原生窗口为Start=0,End=999999,Win_length=1000000；为0基闭区间式，不能直接当BED半开输入。
GFF基因坐标与BLAST位点记录须确认基准/方向；EH23b chr4/5/8/X已作者翻转。
author RData及4组exact source plot_data提供已处理绘图层；新数据仍须重新处理与QC。
processing: 先选SYN/INV，源脚本按ref/query相邻间距<400kb合并SYN；合并顺序必须验证，不能盲目套阈值。
gribbon取每个block的上下界，10点logistic插值，每块20 polygon顶点；invert交换query_start/query_end；chrX编号10，双单倍型x偏移±0.2。
CpG%=CG/Win_length×100，每条chr先平移到0再除其max，iCGs=1-CGs；rect宽度映射iCGs，因此是chr内相对CpG尺度。
get_wins中间阶段按各assembly独立min-max生成gcntsc与临时颜色（Rmd318–320）；最终绘图前Rmd450–477覆盖gcol，两个haplotype共同max(gcnt)=156，颜色索引as.integer(gcnt/shared_max*99+1)，100色magma(begin=.1,end=.9)。迁移时保持共同尺度；共同max为0须显式处理。
原脚本基因归窗要求V4>=Start,V5<End，属于完整包含规则；跨窗口基因不应被默认为start-bin。
精确保留pEH23中的SYN/INV顶点、1487窗口和marker值；不是重跑SyRI/GFF生成。

ggpubr: ggarrange in old Ideo_plot combined panels, final publication assembly not supplied
packages_by_role.SyRI: upstream event classification only, not rerun

palette.gene_density: 100-level magma(.1,.9), shared EH23a/b max156; as.integer(gcnt/shared_max*99+1); 88 realized colours. Per-assembly gcntsc is intermediate only.

layout: 两haploidy中心±.2、细柱chrom_wid=.05，外侧条thinw=.28；灰SYN先铺底、橙INV覆上、热色窗和marker后画。
沿共同Mb轴、各chr保持真实长度；色条随主图区，独立标genes per1Mb，宽度不复用gene色标。
原Ideo_plot有6.5×6.5in导出注释及2:1纵向ggarrange旧版；不能当当前Nature终稿尺寸合同。

learned_contract.source_legacy_locator: SexChromosomes/README.md says Fig2/ED2; final official panel is ED9c/d, verified by XML and original image.
learned_contract.chart: X/Y基因位置–性别平均表达差散点＋上侧频数step＋右侧逆累积分布
learned_contract.when: 已经取得同一参考chr、gene start、male/female average TPM与synteny category，需要显示位置聚集及表达差分布；不是差异检验。
input_contract: 11列TSV:labelID,geneID,start,stop,syntenyID,femaleID,femaleAvgTPM,maleID,maleAvgTPM,tpmDiff,annotation。
geneID保留assembly.chr.gene原键；花/叶、sex、replicate元数据先匹配后按组算平均，零表达保留。
仅给均值TSV时只能描述；不得把每个基因或marker点当生物重复。
flower_male_biased_expression.txt由male_only与male_higher_exp_min5TPM_diffs拼接；缺原输入就保留missing，不能模拟替代原值。
processing: 作者按sex/tissue选所有replicate，以算术mean TPM保留零值；bias用abs(mean_male-mean_female)>=5TPM，exclusive用另一sex零表达。
minimum avgTPM意图为1；源码exclusive分支使用>threshold，而原图注写>=1，临界1需单独审。
y=log2(mean_maleTPM+1)-log2(mean_femaleTPM+1)，不是log2TPM差无伪计数，也不是DESeq2效应。
x=start/1e6；分synteny类别散点alpha=.5；上侧每1Mb频数，右侧每.5单位逆累计density分布。
右侧cumulative=-1且density=True为每类别归一累计概率，不是频数；不能与顶部频数混用单位。

processing: Upstream original intersects RNA/protein/methylation IDs; represents log2 effects; DPM constraints(1,1,-1) in RNA/P/M order prioritise direct RNA-protein and inverse methylation relationships.

Original selector expects missing pvals_merged column. Unchanged pure function fails KeyError; independent audit explicitly uses available Brown and DPM columns in separate outputs, preserving gene keys. Fig5D caption specifies Brown FDR<0.001; source column does not identify which merged method was intended.

Independent BH adjustment of all9209 merged P values: Brown caption-guided q<0.001 selects645 rows; DPM schema-adapted selects481; overlap481/Brown-only164/DPM-only0. Both score matrices use capped -log10(unadjusted input P), +1 where FC>0 and -1 otherwise, includingzero; not sign(0)=0.

Directional agreement tests signed-score RNA/P concordance and M opposition, allowingzero scores. Raw has23FC zeros, none DPM-selected. DPM-adapted359cyan/122orange; Brown caption-guided375cyan/270orange. P=1 maps0; blanket missing→category conversion forbidden.

Euclidean+complete row clustering over fixedR/P/M signed-P scores, no column clustering; CGC22 DPM-selected/29Brown-selected. Separate plot-data and cluster-order files retained. Neither caption-guided reprocessing nor the DPM adaptation is original author end-to-end runtime.
Published Fig5D legend states signed -log10(FDR), while source uses unadjusted input P for cells. Explicitly resolve this discrepancy before reuse; never silently relabel signed-P as FDR.

processing: Upstream original intersects RNA/protein/methylation IDs; represents log2 effects; DPM constraints(1,1,-1) in RNA/P/M order prioritise direct RNA-protein and inverse methylation relationships.

Original selector expects missing pvals_merged column. Unchanged pure function fails KeyError; independent audit explicitly uses available Brown and DPM columns in separate outputs, preserving gene keys. Fig5D caption specifies Brown FDR<0.001; source column does not identify which merged method was intended.

Independent BH adjustment of all9209 merged P values: Brown caption-guided q<0.001 selects645 rows; DPM schema-adapted selects481; overlap481/Brown-only164/DPM-only0. Both score matrices use capped -log10(unadjusted input P), +1 where FC>0 and -1 otherwise, includingzero; not sign(0)=0.

Directional agreement tests signed-score RNA/P concordance and M opposition, allowingzero scores. Raw has23FC zeros, none DPM-selected. DPM-adapted359cyan/122orange; Brown caption-guided375cyan/270orange. P=1 maps0; blanket missing→category conversion forbidden.

Euclidean+complete row clustering over fixedR/P/M signed-P scores, no column clustering; CGC22 DPM-selected/29Brown-selected. Separate plot-data and cluster-order files retained. Neither caption-guided reprocessing nor the DPM adaptation is original author end-to-end runtime.
Published Fig5D legend states signed -log10(FDR), while source uses unadjusted input P for cells. Explicitly resolve this discrepancy before reuse; never silently relabel signed-P as FDR.

learned_contract.chart: 富集网络：通路节点证据饼图、共基因联系、方向法gain/loss分区与符号轮廓
learned_contract.when: 多个组学的通路证据需要呈现相互重叠与方法一致性；节点饼块表示证据类别，不表示细胞比例或因果贡献。
input_contract: same keyed genes,P and declared effect directions from three modalities
GO/Reactome GMT and actual eligible-gene background
Brown/DPM adjusted pathway results and contributing modalities
exact Cytoscape session/layout/edge similarity threshold required for full final-network reproduction; absent from pinned repository
processing: Set scores order protein,rna,methylation with constraints(-1,-1,+1); this is sign-equivalent to(1,1,-1) but must follow each source's modality order.
ActivePathways Brown/DPM with gene-set size10–750, cutoff0.10, significant0.05; bound these to the actual package version2.0.3 and declared background. No inference rerun in this learning task.
Combine term IDs from both methods; preserve evidence modalities; build binary protein/rna/methylation/combined columns and Cytoscape piechart attribute instructions.

directional_impact0=maintained,1=lost,2=gained; export pathway min adjusted P acrossmethods and matching GMT. This aggregated min serves display/export; do not treat it as a new corrected multiple-testing value.
Pinned input row names are implicit, source df$gene absent; comment10902 differs from downloaded9209. New transfer requires explicit keys/eligible-universe QC before enrichment.
R script exports Cytoscape input only; graphical node/edge layout, theme labels, grouping backgrounds and outline symbols are not encoded.

layout.original_observed: F beside narrowD with spacious distinct functional modules, light-blue edges, dark borders; semantic gains region palegreen and losses region palepink; boxed evidence/outline legend. Fig3E has analogous functional groups
layout.code_confirmed: only subgroup/pathway/GMT exports; no node coordinates or final rendering call
layout.export: COMBINED__subgroups.txt, COMBINED__pathways.txt, COMBINED__pathways.gmt; final figure geometry absent
layout.transfer_boundary: Do not replace the network with arbitrary colored circles or invent pairwise weights. Recompute/reuse a declared similarity layout and show its provenance.

colors.original_observed: colored pie wedges represent evidence classes; shared/non-directional/directional outlines categorical; backgroundgain/loss categories, not continuous statistical values
colors.boundary: Source values retained; observed lightblue/palegreen/palepink and border styles have no pinned numeric hex/stroke/layout coordinates.

plot_recipes.chart: 23条染色体核型＋密度折线＋HDR背景＋HOR条
plot_recipes.when: 连续基因组窗口量值与区段注释，需要在同一参考组装坐标上定位峰。
input_contract: chromosome lengths and explicit chr order
SNP BED chr,start,end,density; half-open windows
HDR intervals and live HOR cytobands
processing: SNP positions stored as sets to avoid duplicate calls; count / actual clipped window length; default10kb.
Density GRanges uses start+1,end; density is a fraction. Preserve author-processed decimals; do not infer exact counts from rounded density.
HDR spans are a separate annotation, not independent replicates or SNP-density uncertainty.
Chr1..22,X explicit order; chromosome lengths fixed to this assembly, not generic hg38.
layout: 原图23行单列，短染色体保持相同Mb长度缩放；每行0-.08共用量值尺度。
蓝紫#5459AC折线；浅灰HDR先画，线后画，黑HOR在基因组基线；数据色与注释色分开。
原R脚本反复y轴/10Mb刻度，最终图尺寸需单独核验；本次169×240mm，6pt刻度、20Mb间隔。
gaps: karyoploteR当前未安装；本轮ggplot2独立适配，不声称作者R脚本完整运行。
输入SyRI坐标基准先核对；作者Python未显式将SNP位置转为0基；边界点须fixture。
窗口长度来自SyRI最大参考端点；真实流程更稳妥的长度来源是指定组装FAI。

源geom_bar无描边；新图加薄深色轮廓。

processing: length=end-start；由_hap1/_hap2解析组，按Group,Chromosome求sum(length)/1e6。

源geom_bar无描边；新图加薄深色轮廓。

learned_contract.title: Inferring and perturbing cell fate regulomes in human brain organoids

inference: Pando framework (manuscript scripts; package linked from README)

migration_gaps: Missing R palette vectors and style helpers, including lineage_colors, age_colors, scale01, article_text and gyylgnbu.
Hardcoded author home and group paths plus external RDS/TSV/fragment and bigWig files.
Python velocity script has syntactically valid R-style rev(c(...)) calls plus external globals cells_use and cc_genes; syntax checks are not execution checks.
Source plot fragments and published artwork use some different colors and logarithm labels; actual input tables and final assembly require separate verification.

plot_recipes.data_type: cluster summaries of RNA and chromVAR motif activity plus cluster metadata
plot_recipes.preplot: pivot longer; scale01 within each gene or motif; shared cluster factors ordered by pseudotime and partitioned by lineage; stack lineage, pseudotime, line and age annotations
plot_recipes.mapping: RNA grayscale; motif yellow-orange-brown; pseudotime reversed magma; categorical annotation named vectors
plot_recipes.layout: six stacked tracks; heights 0.8,0.8,1.5,1.5,20,20; 0.02 cm facet spacing; no discrete expansion
plot_recipes.migration: Keep common cluster order across both modalities and annotation bars; label each modality and within-feature normalization; add the user-required thin outlines to bars.

plot_recipes.data_type: tidygraph node and edge tables with saved UMAP coordinates, network centrality and per-edge adjusted P values
plot_recipes.preplot: reuse node UMAP1/UMAP2; identify branch-enriched peak edges; compute branch-specific target proportions
plot_recipes.mapping: global: node size PageRank, node fill mean_ranked_pt reversed magma, edge alpha -log10(padj); branch panels: pale context edges and black enriched edges
plot_recipes.migration: Reuse coordinates AND identical limits and size scale across comparative subgraphs. Do not recompute a layout for each branch. Separate edge confidence from edge coefficient sign. Source branch scripts need external graph tables.

plot_recipes.data_type: TF by lineage effect table plus guide support and number of consistent guides
plot_recipes.preplot: filter cmh_consistent results; use explicit TF and lineage factor orders; join guide-support annotations
plot_recipes.mapping: diverging reversed brewer.rdylbu with limits -1.5 to 1.5; support dots; narrow n_guide strip; widths 5 to 0.5
plot_recipes.migration: Keep effect colors and guide-support marks semantically distinct; preserve source FDR. Published legend says log2(odds ratio), while helper computes natural log and replaces infinite log values with zero. Verify the actual precomputed TSV before matching scale or numerical values.

plot_recipes.data_type: pruned directed GLI3 regulation paths with TF labels and signed coefficients
plot_recipes.preplot: filter differential-expression-supported paths; prune parent paths; convert edges to tidygraph; join pathway classes
plot_recipes.mapping: edge sign and TF-only labels; gray nodes and small rounded label boxes
plot_recipes.layout: tree, circular=TRUE; geom_edge_diagonal; reverse y and coord_flip; export 5 by 5 cm
plot_recipes.migration: Tree drawing requires an explicitly pruned hierarchy; retain the full network separately. Published activation edges are blue and repression edges pink, whereas this code uses #B94D60/#70AD8C. Choose and record palette version rather than claiming exact color reproduction.

plot_recipes.published_reference: Fig.1b,2b; custom differential-coverage helper related to Fig.4h
plot_recipes.data_type: fragment coverage, genomic annotations, peak intervals and motif/TF-region associations
plot_recipes.preplot: select one GRanges region; group fragment coverage by lineage; for differential coverage average within bins and subtract cov_FALSE from cov_TRUE
plot_recipes.layout: CoveragePlot / AnnotationPlot / PeakPlot / motif track, heights 10,1,1,1
plot_recipes.migration: All panels need matching genome build, genomic interval and x expansion. DiffCoveragePlot currently plots bin IDs, so convert to genomic bin centers before combining with base-pair tracks. Full published CUT&Tag plus DA assembly is not confirmed by these snippets.

entries.claim_boundary: Source/code/visual study is reusable guidance; new-input rendering and final-size review are required.

(B) Schematic representation of the gabrg2 protein, and alignment of the Amur sleeper gabrg2 amino acids sequence with the corresponding sequences of 13 vertebrates, including nine teleosts (Bufo bufo, frog; Gallus gallus, chicken; Mus musculus, mouse; Homo sapiens, human). The 14 positively selected sites in the Amur sleeper gabrg2 sequence are highlighted in red. (C) F-box only protein 2 (fbxo2) gene family has a significant expansion in the Amur sleeper genome (left) compared with other teleosts. The Amur sleeper has six copies of this gene, whereas other species only have 1 or 2. Alignment of six copies of fbxo2 from Amur sleeper with the corresponding proteins from other teleosts identified two specific 2-amino acid deletions (right).

publication.title: Domesticated cannabinoid synthases amid a wild mosaic cannabis pangenome

learned_contract.method_pattern: native BUSCOplot::gg_line_map + synthase point overlays; selected single complex genomic panel
learned_contract.learning_scope: Native plotting code, exact processed inputs, ordering/anchor/filter semantics, physical layout and new semantic color; no rawNGS analysis

source_assets.acquisition: byte-identical copy of previously acquired official article XML; original retained
byte-identical copy of pinned shared repository README; original retained

source_images.pairing_status: Shared README Fig4d + final article Fig4 caption bind author old Fig5D directory
Secondary only; x order and style differ from current Rmd/final Fig4d, so not final layout authority

code_locators.purpose: Exclude SN1v3 haplotypes and overlay three query high-stringency matches
Processed matrix public-column exclusion, four chemotypes, ordered 76 columns; named inversions are only reordered here
Per-sample BUSCO anchor subtraction and author mean imputation of missing anchor
Native BUSCOplot map plus low/high synthase marker layers and chemotype separators
Local 0–4.1 Mb scale-limit view; top chemotype labels, bottom anchor annotation and right synthase key
Native gg_line_map: ortholog-id keyed long table; remove NA rows; BUSCO points and connecting geom_line; cyclic eight-color magma source palette
Native full_table schema checker; author bypasses this for already processed numeric coordinate matrix

repositories.license: No LICENSE in pinned repository, no permissive license assumed

processing: Read author 147 BUSCO x 86 numeric bp matrix with BUSCO IDs as row names; remove 10 public-reference columns and preserve author I/II/III/IV order 32/16/20/8.
Move five named Type I inversion haplotypes to group end; source does not re-flip their coordinates.
Subtract BUSCO_ID=127689at71240 separately per column and from synthase sstart; missing NLv1b anchor is the author's mean of 75 available anchors, not a newly observed coordinate.
Low-stringency marker table is supplied author BLAST output after removing SN1v3a/b; source does not apply a new >=90 predicate at plotting stage.
High-stringency rows require qseqid AB212829.1 THCAS / AB292682.1 CBDAS / LY658671.1 CBCAS, gaps==0 and pident>=98 (percentage units).

Preserve native line_na_rm=TRUE semantics, which remove missing rows and can connect nonadjacent retained samples; use explicit 0–4.1e6 scale limits as author local-view selection, not coord_cartesian replacement.

Display only source-selected local view: 173 finite visible BUSCO cells from five ortholog rows, 2600 low-stringency rows and 106 high-stringency rows; retain full inputs and audit excluded coordinates.

input_contract.experimental_unit: assembled haplotype/reference chromosome, not independent biological replicate
input_contract.main_matrix: numeric bp positions, BUSCO ID row keys, sample columns, NA accepted and audited
input_contract.marker_table: author BLAST tabular percent-identity/gaps/reference query and sstart point positions

high_stringency_markers.predicates: qseqid in three declared references, gaps == 0, pident >= 98

source_density_contract.observation: Wide scatter-line map, top I-IV labels, left0–4 Mb axis, bottom anchor annotation, right vertical four-triangle key. Final paper omits crowded haplotype tick labels.
source_density_contract.boundary_status: visual estimate for planning; not an automated measurement
source_density_contract.adaptation: Standalone selected Fig4d, retain source plot aspect and density; keep original order in plot data and x-label choice explicit in fresh CP2.

recolor_proposal.BUSCO: subdued cyclic categorical palette; no abundance or functional interpretation

statistical_analysis.plan: Descriptive coordinate map only; do not add ANOVA or significance tests to comparative genome positions

known_failures: Directory name Fig5D is historical; official panel is Fig4d. Do not label the delivered standalone panel as complete Fig4.
NLv1b anchor imputed from mean; disclose in source methods/QC and preserve author policy when reproducing, not promote to generic alignment method.
Rmd caption line172 misidentifies CBCAS accession as AB292682.1; executable query is LY658671.1. Executable >=98 is inclusive, although caption says greater than98.
Source native gg_line_map uses processed matrix with check_table=FALSE; manual schema/finite-ID checks are required.
Scale limits discard out-of-window points before line geometry; localview excludes10571 finite BUSCO coordinates by design.
PAG2024 source PNG has a different haplotype order from current author Rmd; use final official Fig4d for geometry, source Rmd for current executable order.
Native package is development version0.0.0.9000, pinned by commit; later package version or ggplot2 may change behavior and needs fresh review.

render_scope.target: Selected original author processed-data panel with new colors

Select matrix columns having retained CBDAS hits; alphabetical order then CBDRx/Abacus/Finola last.
No BUSCO anchoring or new orientation correction: keep original full chr7 bp coordinates and all147 ortholog rows.
Use native BUSCOplot::gg_line_map(check_table=FALSE,size=1.2,lalpha=0.2), then author CBDAS connecting path and outlined filled triangle markers.

known_failures: Author directory says Supplemental_Figure23, but final supplement mapping is unverified. Label author-public-chr7 and do not fabricate a formal final figure number.
Caption pidentity>=0.98 uses fractional notation while data and executable filter use percent>=98.

23 CBDAS hits have reverse BLAST sstart>send; source uses sstart for point position. Preserve this point convention and do not swap endpoints or flip entire chromosome.
Native line_na_rm removes missing rows, which may connect orthologs across nonadjacent retained samples; preserve and describe native behavior.

original_figure_review.caption: Directional integration of transcriptomics data from functional experiments of HOXA10-AS lncRNA in GBM cells.A We integrated differential gene expression data from HOXA10-AS knockdown (KD) and overexpression (OE) experiments from a previous study27 that compared sets of three replicates. DPM prioritised genes that showed different fold-change (FC) directions in KD and OE experiments and penalised genes with matching directions using the constraints vector (CV) [KD = −1, OE = +1]. B Scatter plot of merged P-values from directional analysis (DPM, Y-axis) and non-directional analysis (the Brown method, X-axis). Prioritised genes with directionally consistent changes are shown on the diagonal or closely below it (blue), while directionally penalised genes with conflicting directional changes are further below the diagonal (red). Unadjusted P-values are shown. C Examples of prioritised genes (top) and penalised genes (bottom). D Venn diagram of enriched pathways found with directional and non-directional analyses (family-wise error rate (FWER) < 0.05). E Enrichment map of pathways and processes from directional and non-directional analyses (FWER < 0.05). Pathways are shown as node in the network that are connected by edges if the pathways share many genes. Subnetworks represent functional themes. Node colours indicate dataset contributions (KD, OE, both, or combined-only). Node size reflects number of genes per pathway. Node outlines show directionally prioritised pathways (spiky edges), directionally penalised pathways (dotted edges), or pathways found using both approaches (solid edges). Major groups of directionally prioritised or penalised pathways are grouped on the right. F Dot plots of significant genes involved in cell migration and oxygen response processes visualised with P-values and fold-change values from the HOXA10-AS transcriptomics study27. Genes penalised in the non-directional analysis are indicated with asterisks. Carets show known cancer genes from the COSMIC Cancer Gene Census database53.

original_figure_review.caption: Directional integration of transcriptomics data from functional experiments of HOXA10-AS lncRNA in GBM cells.A We integrated differential gene expression data from HOXA10-AS knockdown (KD) and overexpression (OE) experiments from a previous study27 that compared sets of three replicates. DPM prioritised genes that showed different fold-change (FC) directions in KD and OE experiments and penalised genes with matching directions using the constraints vector (CV) [KD = −1, OE = +1]. B Scatter plot of merged P-values from directional analysis (DPM, Y-axis) and non-directional analysis (the Brown method, X-axis). Prioritised genes with directionally consistent changes are shown on the diagonal or closely below it (blue), while directionally penalised genes with conflicting directional changes are further below the diagonal (red). Unadjusted P-values are shown. C Examples of prioritised genes (top) and penalised genes (bottom). D Venn diagram of enriched pathways found with directional and non-directional analyses (family-wise error rate (FWER) < 0.05). E Enrichment map of pathways and processes from directional and non-directional analyses (FWER < 0.05). Pathways are shown as node in the network that are connected by edges if the pathways share many genes. Subnetworks represent functional themes. Node colours indicate dataset contributions (KD, OE, both, or combined-only). Node size reflects number of genes per pathway. Node outlines show directionally prioritised pathways (spiky edges), directionally penalised pathways (dotted edges), or pathways found using both approaches (solid edges). Major groups of directionally prioritised or penalised pathways are grouped on the right. F Dot plots of significant genes involved in cell migration and oxygen response processes visualised with P-values and fold-change values from the HOXA10-AS transcriptomics study27. Genes penalised in the non-directional analysis are indicated with asterisks. Carets show known cancer genes from the COSMIC Cancer Gene Census database53.

processing: Read immutable author saved RDS; use in-memory HiCExperiment scores/interactions. Preserve 19667 records, 2103634 raw count sum, 200 contiguous 5kb bins and exact chr17 coordinates.

Author loop annotations cover chr17 beyond selected matrix. Filter score>=0.4 & qvalue<=1e-6 exactly (1639/2419), then native both-anchor overlap leaves31 visible loops; retain all2419 in provenance/plot_data with selection flags.
Heatmap score is balanced interaction frequency transformed log10; preserve limits[-4,-1.2]. Source squishes115 low and396 high records; neither drop nor reinterpret saturation as missing.
Native square plot mirrors record centers;39334 tile rows including doubled diagonal entries. Preserve upper/lower symmetry and source 1:1 physical data aspect.
Do not call import/refocus/zoom: RDS fileName points to an unavailable backing mcool; direct in-memory nativeplotMatrix needs no backing file. Do not run HiCool/getLoops/chromosight.
Current book deployment uses HiContacts1.15.2; pinned package source is1.15.3. Record version distinction and validate fresh native output rather than claim byte-identical publication output.

learning.input_contract: Forty official rows: ten P. koreana-to-other-species pairs times four A/B transition states; each row is a precomputed within-pair proportion.
learning.transform: Read ratios from Sup Tab5 and preserve values; verify each four-state group sums to one within 1e-12; no second normalization.
learning.join_order: Use author factor order Ppse, Pwua, Pyun, Psze, Plas, Psim, Pade, Pdav, Prot, Pqio; categories A-B, B-A, A-A, B-B. Bottom-to-top stack order is reversed by ggplot2 default.
learning.package_roles: ggplot2::geom_col and position_stack draw exact ratios; ggplot2::annotation_raster adds the ordinal Ks rank band on the same axes; ggplot2 scales format the 0-100 axis; BioFigure bf_render_png performs typography and layout preflight.
learning.layout_rules: One wide panel; four-item legend inside the top border; bars above a shallow peach Ks rank band; ten italic angled species labels below; panel tag b at the far upper-left; pure white canvas; 90 by 54 mm panel canvas inferred from the crop occupying about half of the full-width source figure.
learning.failure_modes: Reject incomplete states, wrong denominator, nonclosed groups, reordered species, palette drift, overlapping labels, and numeric Ks claims unsupported by source data.

scientific_scope.denominator: Homologous 40-kb bins within each species pair
scientific_scope.experimental_or_replicate_unit: No independent replicate claim; descriptive species-pair compositions only
scientific_scope.claim_boundary: No significance, confidence interval, or species-level replication inferred from bins
scientific_scope.ks_annotation: Species order is source-supported; numeric Ks values are absent from matched input. Band is an ordinal visual reconstruction only.

learned_contract.independent_transfer_status: not-tested; source and author figure were inspected before writing the independent renderer

entries.claim_boundary: Source/code/visual study is reusable guidance; new-input rendering and final-size review are required.

learning.transform: Generate a rooted binary hierarchy independently; aggregate descendant counts and compositions bottom-up; use sqrt-scaled edge width and RGB-weighted descendant colour; stop pruning by depth or descendant-leaf threshold.
learning.join_order: All overlays join by stable node_id; panels c, d and e reuse the same pruned node set and coordinates; the tissue dictionary and order are identical in all panels.
learning.package_roles: grid draws branches, annular composition glyphs, modularity circles, node labels and layout; ragg writes the inspected PNG; base PDF and svglite write vector formats; systemfonts resolves Helvetica.
learning.layout_rules: Four square black data fields on a white 183 by 154 mm canvas; panel letters and short headings inside the upper-left; one shared 11-item legend in a reserved external bottom strip.
learning.failure_modes: Reject disconnected clusters, hidden pruning, equal branch widths when abundance is claimed, mixed modularity and ID overlays, clipped panel tags, legend overlap, stale tissue colours, or biological claims from synthetic values.

composition_closure.evidence: All 191 node tissue-proportion vectors close to 1; maximum absolute closure error is 1.11e-15.

pruned_tree_partition.evidence: The pruned display contains 51 nodes and 26 terminal clades derived from one traversal; panels c, d and e reuse this exact layout.

claim_boundary_declared.evidence: The design, source lock, figure record and review state that fixed-seed synthetic values do not reproduce original numbers, topology or biology.

family.evidence: Both source and output use radial rooted clade trees rather than disconnected embeddings, with full and pruned states shown separately.

panel_topology.evidence: The four-panel reading order is complete tree, pruned tree, split modularity and stable node identifiers, with one shared legend below.

required_structures.evidence: All eight declared structures are visible and traceable to node, edge, composition or overlay fields in the saved plot data.

typography.evidence: Helvetica panel letters, short headings, node IDs and 11 legend labels remain readable at the 183 by 154 mm final size.

annotation.evidence: Modularity marks occur only in panel d and node IDs only in panel e; panel letters were moved inside after clipping was observed.

information_density.evidence: The 191-node full tree remains distinguishable from the 51-node pruned tree; the external legend does not reduce tree space or overlap marks.

learning.failure_modes: Reject continuous bars without chromosome gaps, nonadjacent unlabelled links, clipped species names, reordered chromosomes, legend overlap, colour-semantic drift, or biological claims from synthetic coordinates.

learning.input_contract: Chromosome lengths, assembly and species identifiers, non-overlapping coordinate intervals with A/B state, one fixed species order, one fixed chromosome order, and a declared coordinate system for every assembly.
learning.transform: Validate complete non-overlapping coverage per species-chromosome; merge adjacent equal states; allocate angular sector width from chromosome length; draw one concentric track per ordered species.
learning.join_order: Chromosome lengths initialize all sectors; interval rows join by chromosome and species; a-k track identifiers and the central dictionary use the exact same outer-to-inner species order.
learning.package_roles: circlize builds coordinate-aware sectors and tracks; ragg exports the inspected PNG; svglite creates vector SVG; rsvg converts the SVG to PDF; systemfonts resolves Arial.
learning.layout_rules: Use a 183 by 170 mm white canvas, a Chr19-Chr01 gap at top for a-k, an open centre for the species dictionary, curved outer chromosome labels, and a reserved right-side A/B legend.
learning.failure_modes: Reject equal-angle sectors when lengths are available, reordered rings, interval gaps or overlaps, continuous palettes for A/B, missing centre key, clipped outer labels, oversized centre hole, or a legend inside data tracks.

source.paper: Shi et al. Nature Ecology & Evolution (2026)

scientific_scope.experimental_or_replicate_unit: Genome assembly; descriptive structural benchmark, no replicate inference
scientific_scope.claim_boundary: Structural and final-size visual reproduction only. Original compartment coordinates, switches, conservation and biological conclusions are excluded.

nineteen_chromosomes.evidence: Chromosome table contains exactly 19 ordered sectors, Chr01 through Chr19.

eleven_species_tracks.evidence: Interval table contains 11 species and 209 species-chromosome combinations.

a_to_k_track_order.evidence: Outer-to-inner track IDs are exactly a through k and map one-to-one to the saved species order.

coordinates_within_bounds.evidence: Every interval starts at or above zero, ends after its start, and remains within its chromosome length.

continuous_nonoverlapping_coverage.evidence: For each of 209 species-chromosome pairs, sorted intervals start at zero, meet exactly at adjacent boundaries, and end at chromosome length.

two_compartment_states.evidence: All 2406 merged intervals use only categorical states A or B.

claim_boundary_declared.evidence: Design, provenance gap record, contract and review exclude original coordinates and biological conclusions.

family.evidence: Both source and output use circular coordinate-aware categorical genome tracks, rather than a radial heatmap with unrelated columns.

panel_topology.evidence: One panel combines outer chromosome labels, 11 concentric tracks, a top a-k key, an open centre dictionary and one external A/B legend.

required_structures.evidence: All six required structures are visible and traceable to chromosome lengths, interval states or the fixed species dictionary.

typography.evidence: Arial chromosome labels, a-k keys, italic taxa and legend remain readable at 183 by 170 mm without collision.

annotation.evidence: Panel b is upper-left; Chr01-Chr19 follow the outer arc; a-k occupy the top gap; the central dictionary and right legend are complete.

information_density.evidence: 2406 merged intervals remain distinguishable as dark or light blue blocks across 11 rings, while white radial and circular gaps preserve sector and track identity.

review.review_scope: Official source, user reference and final-size PNG were opened. Structural visual fidelity only; original coordinate and biological fidelity are excluded.
